title: Google describes a hill-climbing workflow for agent evaluation
dek: The unit of improvement is the complete agent system, not an isolated model score.
evidence: Vendor engineering walkthrough; not independent results
takeaway: Track full traces and per-case outcomes on a frozen regression set. Do not promote a model or prompt change based only on a mean score.

sections.title: Context

bullets.detail: An agent is a system of model, prompt, tools and permissions. A model upgrade can improve one answer while silently breaking tool use elsewhere.

paragraphs: Why evals regress: An agent is a system of model, prompt, tools and permissions. A model upgrade can improve one answer while silently breaking tool use elsewhere.

sections.title: What's new

bullets.detail: Google's Agents CLI runs cases (`eval generate`), grades complete traces, diffs runs, clusters recurring failures and optionally optimizes prompts.
In the walkthrough, a prompt change discouraged necessary tool calls; responses looked plausible but lost grounded information.

paragraphs: Five-stage loop: Google's Agents CLI runs cases (`eval generate`), grades complete traces, diffs runs, clusters recurring failures and optionally optimizes prompts.
Concrete failure: In the walkthrough, a prompt change discouraged necessary tool calls; responses looked plausible but lost grounded information.

sections.title: Evidence & limitations

bullets.detail: Four test cases fell from a mean 4.00 to 2.75 on a five-point response-quality rubric. That tiny dataset demonstrates detection, not a production failure rate.
Exact case-level traces and rubric versions matter more than a single mean; tool-call differences can reveal regressions invisible in final-text scoring.

paragraphs: Illustrative regression: Four test cases fell from a mean 4.00 to 2.75 on a five-point response-quality rubric. That tiny dataset demonstrates detection, not a production failure rate.
Reproducibility: Exact case-level traces and rubric versions matter more than a single mean; tool-call differences can reveal regressions invisible in final-text scoring.

sections.title: Why it matters

bullets.detail: Gate changes on frozen per-case tasks, tool actions, unsupported claims, cost and latency, with manual review of material regressions.
If five failures stem from missing retrieval, repair tool selection once rather than rewriting five unrelated answers.

paragraphs: Promote systems, not prompts: Gate changes on frozen per-case tasks, tool actions, unsupported claims, cost and latency, with manual review of material regressions.
